blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from Muse's presale list (2026-11-01). Prices appear only where the source dates them within three months. Paragon presale data is still to be merged, and projects sold through private channels may be missing.

The list holds 15 presale projects in Langley with estimated completion between 2027 and 2028: 11 in 2027, 4 in 2028. By type, that is 10 condo projects, 3 townhome projects, 1 mixed condo and townhome project, 1 house project.

5 of the 15 have a price published and dated within the last three months. The lowest published starting price is at Solana: from $350,000. For the other 10, the price is either not published or the price I have is too old to show, so ask me for the current list.
A deposit structure is published for 12 of the 15.
Developers with more than one project here: Leone Homes (2), Whitetail Homes (2), Wesmont Homes (2), Zenterra Developments (2).
The largest project with a confirmed home count is Eden at 303 homes.

faq.q: Do I pay property transfer tax on a Langley presale?
faq.a: Often not on a principal residence: BC's Newly Built Home Exemption fully exempts a qualifying purchase at a fair market value of $1,100,000 or less, with a partial exemption phasing out to $1,150,000, effective April 1, 2024 — and you do not need to be a first-time buyer

faq.q: Can a first-time buyer get the GST back on a new Langley home?
faq.a: Yes: under Bill C-4 (royal assent March 13, 2026, per CRA guidance) an eligible first-time buyer receives a rebate of 100% of the GST on a newly constructed home valued up to $1 million, gradually reduced between $1 million and $1.5 million, with no rebate at $1.5 million or more

faq.q: How long can I take to cancel a presale after signing?
faq.a: Seven days: under REDMA s.21 you may rescind by written notice to the developer within seven days after the later of the purchase agreement date and the date the developer obtained your receipt for the Disclosure Statement
